signals_info.description: Whether the associated intersection conflict area is occupied; 0 means unoccupied.

time_info.description: Bounded conflict-area state window including the current time.

nl_Literal_translation_en: At some time from now through the next 5 seconds, the intersection conflict area shall be unoccupied.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 从当前起至接下来的 5 秒内，路口冲突区域应至少有一个时刻处于未被占用状态。
nl_Paraphrase_en: Within the 5-second window including now, the intersection conflict area shall be clear at least once.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 在包含当前时刻的 5 秒窗口内，路口冲突区域应至少有一个时刻处于无占用状态。
